hypotheses.R1_cluster64_routes_are_predictive: With budget 16, the frozen 64-cluster router reaches median full-score correlation at least 0.85 on every corpus.
hypotheses.R2_routing_beats_fixed_spectrum: With budget 16, the 64-cluster router improves correlation over fixed leading eigenmodes by at least 0.15 on every corpus.
hypotheses.R3_cluster256_approaches_oracle: With budget 16, the 256-cluster router is within 0.05 correlation of oracle adaptive selection on every corpus.
hypotheses.R4_router_transfers_ood: The 64-cluster budget-16 correlation drops by at most 0.05 from FineWeb on each OOD corpus.
hypotheses.R5_router_predicts_support: The 64-cluster budget-16 route recalls at least 40% of the oracle top-16 support on every corpus.
hypotheses.R6_routes_use_a_broad_dictionary: Across 64 cluster routes, the median per-query union contains at least 128 distinct modes.
